transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function for the Rust 1.96 target body.
Adapted the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter, removed `const`, and named the return value for Verus; the public target body is not externalized.

Kept the public target flow as `match split_at_checked(slice, mid) { Some(pair) => pair, None => ... }` and reused the reviewed `core::slice::split_at_checked` relation from the generated harness to prove the exact-vstd subrange postcondition.

Isolated only the unsupported `panic!("mid > len")` macro expansion behind a named external-body helper with `ensures false`; the public target proves the branch unreachable under `mid <= slice@.len()`.
Attached the exact-vstd precondition and subrange ensures from the copied baseline: `mid <= slice.len()`, `ret.0@ == slice@.subrange(0, mid)`, and `ret.1@ == slice@.subrange(mid, slice@.len())`.
